description: This file contains the implementation of HorizontalXAxisRenderer class responsible for rendering the horizontal X axis in charting components of the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for initialization, formatting, drawing the axis, and calculating axis-specific values and tick positions.

classes.name: HorizontalXAxisRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders the X axis for horizontal chart types such as Column2D and Line within the PDFsharp charting library.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the renderer info object for the X axis based on current chart data, including axis value calculations and label preparations.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space requirements for axis titles and tick labels, updating renderer info accordingly.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the horizontal X axis, including tick marks, labels, and axis title, onto the graphics context.

methods.name: CalculateXAxisValues
methods.description: Determines minimum and maximum scale, major/minor tick spacing, and tick width based on chart data.

methods.name: InitXValues
methods.description: Initializes or generates the X values (tick labels) for the axis.

methods.name: GetTickMarkPos
methods.description: Calculates the start and end positions for major and minor tick marks based on tick mark types.
